hooks.text: 闪避、冲刺和连招建立在简单但可精通的操作上
hooks.excerpt: Dodge, dash, and unleash combos with satisfying precision. The core controls are simple, but leave plenty of room to master your moves.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 八种元素可与主副武器和英雄能力混搭
hooks.excerpt: With eight elemental types, multiple primary and secondary weapons, and a wide range of hero abilities, each run gives you the freedom to try something new.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 秘密房间、随机事件和怪异小挑战藏在关卡角落
hooks.excerpt: Secret rooms. Random events. Weird mini-challenges. There’s always something unexpected waiting — and often, it pays off big.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 战斗是挺爽的，但我打不过第四图啊，想玩新武器也玩不了。

opinions.text: 游戏好玩，但有的地方没给描述，我补充一个点希望帮到后面的玩家：局外成长解锁到8个虫核位，另外两个虫核位要在难度4以上解锁了装备合成之后，在局内收集金木冰火土五个元素碎片装备才能解锁，属于局内构筑。
